text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, shall we hold a brief strategy meeting?
Regarding our upcoming races.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In order to defeat the JRA,
we should spare no time in our efforts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since Furioso came to the JRA,
she has seemed wound tight without a moment's rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It'd be best to let off some steam properly here.
Like spending time on the beach like back in Funabashi—
choice_data_list: …Wouldn't the beach be a nice calm place to talk?
…Don't you think we could have a nice calm chat at the beach?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I see... That sounds like it could spark some good ideas.
Let's go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"The scent of the sea breeze... Yes.
This should help me come up with a brilliant idea."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To help her relax naturally like this,
I need to divert her attention even more.
At times like this—
choice_data_list: Let's keep our hands moving while we think. It'll help your brain work.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
When it comes to using your hands on the beach—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, how about we look for sea glass while we're at it?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
You know, back when we were in Funabashi. We used to do that sometimes.
Searching until just before the sun went down.
choice_data_list: Yes, that's it! Let's definitely do that!
Yeah, that's it! Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—In other words, to seize an opening against the URA Umamusume,
I believe the time spent on advance research will be vital.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, this piece of sea glass is nice.
The indentation is smooth and feels great to touch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso's tension is gradually softening.
At this rate, her smile should return by the time we head back.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, if it isn't Furioso and the others!
What brings you around here?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Not really... I was merely collecting sea glass.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Those pretty pebbles?!
Some kiddos playin' on the beach invited me over, so I just gathered 'em up, too!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Look at that, a massive haul! 
My own genius terrifies me!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...It's so-so.
For someone who grew up in Funabashi, it's pretty normal.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Bold words indeed.
Then show me... the extent of your skill!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we absolutely must find
more sea glass than No Reason-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso began searching for sea glass,
breathing heavily through her nose.
Was she really relaxing and having fun like this?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...In Funabashi, we gathered whole bags full, didn't we?
Even among our group, you and I were the top two, Trainer."
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah. That did happen, didn't it?
Y-Yeah. That did happen, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Finding spots where seaweed like this washes ashore
always gets my blood pumping.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's show No Reason-san.
The power, the technique, and the pride of Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Found a top-quality emerald green one.
There's even a perfectly symmetrical, mint-condition piece here.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Oho, this tide pool behind the rock...
—You can't fool my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To let such a prime opportunity slip by,
No Reason-san is far too soft...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: With this, it's our—Funabashi's victory!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... It's your win!
Good grief, you guys are really something, huh.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you understand now.
That just like in races, Funabashi is unbeatable on the beach too.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The experience and technique I honed in Funabashi won't lose to anyone.
Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: The Funabashi spirit is right here!
Bring it on, whoever you are.
Bring it on, no matter who the opponent is!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The experience and technique I honed in Funabashi won't lose to anyone.
Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: The Funabashi spirit is right here!
Bring it on, whoever you are.
Bring it on, no matter who the opponent is!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let's keep this momentum going
and make the name of Funabashi echo throughout Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hold it right there! I may have lost, but my spirit remains unbroken!
If you wish to advance, you must break my will first!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Interesting. Allow me to engrave the name
'Funabashi' into your heart once more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I was swept up in the fever
and fired up right along with everyone...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso didn't seem to have relaxed much either.
I'll have to take her out again to bring back her smile...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "That is correct. In Tracen Academy, we are number one at sea glass collecting."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, sit back and puff out your chest for now.
In the meantime, I shall gather the strength to overturn the realm!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Trainer, resuming sea glass search.
Until time runs out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso's inner fighting spirit
is blazing up fiercely...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems difficult to get her to relax right now.
To bring back Furioso's smile, I should take her out again...!
